name: Oimachi
tagline: Three lines, a station mall and full-size supermarkets — everything within the station area.
summary: Oimachi is served by the JR Keihin-Tohoku Line, the Tokyu Oimachi Line and the Rinkai Line, putting Shinagawa six minutes away, Tokyo Station 18 and Shibuya 15. Atre Oimachi and large supermarkets sit right at the station, so daily life happens without going anywhere else. Rent is lower than nearby Shinagawa or Osaki despite the convenience.
goodFor: People commuting to Shinagawa or Tokyo Station
People who want everything at the station
People who want redundancy across lines
notFor: People who want a quiet residential street
People who care about neighborhood style
People optimising purely for low rent
residentComment: As a practical base this station is very strong, and having three lines means disruptions rarely strand you. The old drinking alleys are still here and evenings are lively, so if you want quiet, consider moving one stop out.
